plan_document_id.description: Software Verification Plan this test plan is derived from (plan-document.id)

objectives.description: Objectives (objective.id) the plan contributes evidence to

activity.description: Whether the plan covers verification (built it right) or validation (built the right thing).

software_level.description: Software level (DO-178C A to E) of the item under verification. Determines which coverage goals (MC/DC only at A) and independence rules apply.

baseline_id.description: ID of the baseline (see baseline schema) the plan is executed against

environment_id.description: Environment record (environment.id); 'environment' stays as free text for compatibility

regression.description: Present when the plan is a regression plan. The scope is the change_impact recorded on the baseline referenced by baseline_id, measured from previous_baseline_id.

previous_baseline_id.description: Baseline the changes are measured from; must match change_impact of the plan's baseline

rationale.description: Why the selected regression scope is sufficient, if it differs from the baseline's change_impact

independence_rules.description: Objectives requiring independence (checker is not the author)

external_refs.description: Jira Fix Version (milestone) and, for Xray/Zephyr, the Test Plan or cycle

key.description: Identifier in that system (Jira issue key, Xray test key, Zephyr key, StrictDoc UID, Fix Version id)

url.description: Resolved URL; the resolver derives it from integration-config when absent

synced_at.description: Last successful sync of this record to that system

title: Test Plan
description: Schema for a test plan: what is verified, against which baseline, in which environment, with which independence rules
